blocks.text: Aap jante hain ke cells ke andar aur bahar cheezon (substances) ka aana jana cell ke kaamon ke liye bohat zaroori hai. Yeh aamad-o-raft nutrients lene, waste nikalne, gases ke tabadle (gas exchange) aur signal transduction ke liye hoti hai. Cells is aamad-o-raft ko control karne ke liye plasma membrane par bharosa karte hain. Membrane transport mechanisms (membrane ke aar-paar le jane ke tareeqe) cell ko homeostasis qaim rakhne, nutrients lene, waste nikalne aur apne mahol se rabta rakhne ke qabil banate hain.
Cell ke mahol ke saath cheezon ka len-den karte hue plasma membrane cell ke andar aur bahar dono taraf equilibrium (tawazun, barabari) qaim rakhti hai.
Yeh tareeqe do qisam ke hain: passive transport (jis mein energy nahi lagti) aur active transport (jis mein energy lagti hai).
Passive Transport
Plasma membrane ke aar-paar molecules ka aisa guzarna jis mein koi energy kharch na ho, passive transport kehlata hai. Is ki qismein yeh hain:
Diffusion

Diffusion kisi cheez (liquid ya gas) ka zyada concentration (ghanapan, yani fi jagah zyada miqdar) wali jagah se kam concentration wali jagah ki taraf kul (net) harkat hai, yani concentration gradient (concentration ke farq) ke saath saath. Jab molecules membrane ke aar-paar diffuse hote hain to cell koi energy kharch nahi karta, is liye diffusion passive transport ki ek qisam hai.

blocks.alt: Waqt ki tarteeb mein teen khane, teeron se jure. Har ek mein surakhon wali membrane jagah ko baant'ti hai; shuru mein neele molecules zyada tar baen aur hare daen hain; dono qismein surakhon se guzarti hain yahan tak ke aakhri khane mein har qism dono taraf barabar phail jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.34: Do qisam ke molecules ki diffusion (textbook ki Figure 3.34 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har qism ke molecules apni zyada concentration se kam concentration ki taraf jate hain, doosri qism se be-niyaz. Aakhir mein dono taraf barabari (equilibrium) ho jati hai; is mein koi energy kharch nahin hoti.
Facilitated Diffusion

Kuch molecules plasma membrane mein maujood transport proteins ki madad se cell ke andar ya bahar jate hain. Jab koi transport protein kisi cheez ko us ke concentration gradient ke saath (zyada se kam concentration ki taraf) le jane mein madad karta hai to is amal ko facilitated diffusion (madad wali diffusion) kehte hain. Yeh bhi passive transport hai kyun ke is mein energy istemal nahi hoti. Facilitated diffusion ki raftaar is par munhasir hai ke membrane mein kitne transport protein molecules maujood hain. Facilitated diffusion mein kaam aane wale transport proteins ki bari qismein yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Plasma membrane (phospholipid bilayer) jis ke aar-paar transport protein hai. Ek taraf ke solute molecules transport protein se guzar kar doosri taraf, apni concentration gradient ke rukh, chale jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.35: Facilitated diffusion (textbook ki Figure 3.35 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

items: Channel Proteins: yeh proteins membrane ke aar-paar hydrophilic (pani pasand) channels (naliyan) banate hain jin se khaas molecules ya ions guzar sakte hain. Yeh gated (darwaze wale) ya non-gated ho sakte hain. Gated channels kisi khaas stimulus par khulte ya band hote hain, jaise voltage ki tabdeeli, ligand ka jurna ya mechanical dabao. Misalen: ion channels (khaas ions jaise Na⁺, K⁺, Ca²⁺, Cl⁻ ko guzarne dete hain) aur aquaporins (pani ke molecules ko tezi se guzarte hain).

Carrier Proteins (Transporters): yeh proteins jis molecule ko le jate hain us se jurte hain, apni shakal badalte hain (conformational change) aur molecule ko membrane ke paar pohancha dete hain. Har carrier sirf apne khaas molecule ke liye hota hai. Yeh saturated (bhar jana) ho sakte hain: jab saare carrier proteins masroof hon to transport ki raftaar zyada se zyada (maximum) ho kar ruk jati hai, aur aage nahi barhti. Misalen: glucose transporters (glucose le jate hain) aur amino acid transporters (khaas amino acids ko cell ke andar ya bahar le jate hain).

rows: Cheezen zyada se kam concentration ki taraf seedha plasma membrane ki lipid bilayer mein se guzarti hain.
Cheezen zyada se kam concentration ki taraf plasma membrane mein lage khaas transport proteins ke zariye guzarti hain.
Passive transport hai; cell se koi energy nahi chahiye.
Yeh bhi passive transport hai; energy nahi chahiye.
Aam taur par chhote, nonpolar molecules jaise oxygen, carbon dioxide aur lipid mein ghulne wali cheezen.
Zyada tar polar ya charged molecules jaise glucose, amino acids aur ions, jo lipid bilayer ke hydrophobic andar wale hisse se aasani se nahi guzar sakte.
Concentration gradient, temperature aur membrane ki permeability par munhasir hai.
Transport proteins ki tadaad aur dastyabi par munhasir hai; jab saare transport proteins bhar jayen (saturated) to raftaar maximum par ruk jati hai.

blocks.text: Osmosis

Woh amal jis mein pani ke molecules cell membrane ke aar-paar zyada (pani ki) concentration wali jagah se kam concentration wali jagah ki taraf diffuse hote hain, osmosis kehlata hai. Kyun ke pani zyada se kam concentration ki taraf ja raha hai, is liye cell ko energy kharch nahi karni parti. Is liye osmosis pani ka passive transport hai. Osmosis ki simt (direction) membrane ke dono taraf solutes (ghule hue maddon) ki concentration par munhasir hai. Pani hamesha hypotonic solution (kam solute wala) se hypertonic solution (zyada solute wala) ki taraf jata hai.

Tonicity ka matlab hai solutions mein solutes ki nisbati (relative) concentration.
Hypertonic solution: jis mein solute zyada ho.
Hypotonic solution: jis mein solute kam ho.
Isotonic solution: jin mein solutes ki concentration barabar ho.

Osmosis selectively permeable (chun kar guzarne dene wali) membrane se hota hai, jo pani ko guzarne deti hai magar bohat se solutes ko rokti hai. Osmosis cell turgor (pani se cell ka tana hua rehna) qaim rakhne ke liye zaroori hai, jo poday ke cells ke liye bohat aham hai, aur cells mein pani ki miqdar barabar rakhne ke liye bhi. Osmosis ki simt aur raftaar osmotic gradient aur membrane ki pani ke liye permeability par munhasir hai. Aquaporins naam ke khaas proteins pani ke molecules ko cell membrane ke paar tezi se guzarte hain, jis se cell mein pani ki miqdar aur hajam (volume) achhi tarah control rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Selectively permeable membrane hypotonic solution (baen) ko hypertonic solution (daen) se alag karti hai. Har solute molecule ke gird pani ke molecules ka guchha hai; azaad pani ke molecules hypotonic taraf zyada hain. Neeche teer pani ka net bahao (net flow) hypotonic se hypertonic taraf dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.36: Molecular satah par osmosis (textbook ki Figure 3.36 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Solute ke gird chipka pani aazadi se nahin ghoom sakta. Hypotonic taraf azaad pani zyada hai, is liye pani ke zyada molecules wahan se membrane paar karte hain: net bahao hypertonic taraf hota hai.

Reverse osmosis pani saaf karne ki aam technology hai jo pani se gandagi (contaminants) aur ghair-zaroori cheezen nikal deti hai. Qudrati osmosis mein pani kam solute concentration se zyada solute concentration ki taraf jata hai, lekin reverse osmosis mein bahar se pressure (dabao) laga kar pani ko semi-permeable membrane ke paar zyada solute concentration se kam solute concentration ki taraf dhakela jata hai. Is se ghule hue salts aur doosri gandagi chhan jati hai aur saaf, mehfooz peene ka pani milta hai. Reverse osmosis water treatment plants, samandari pani ko meetha karne wale plants (desalination) aur gharelu water filters mein aam istemal hota hai.
blocks.title: Reverse osmosis

blocks.alt: Do U-tubes, har ek ke neeche semipermeable membrane jo concentrated solution aur contaminants (baen bazu) ko khalis pani (solvent, daen bazu) se alag karti hai. Osmosis: pani khalis pani se concentrated solution mein jata hai aur us ki satah oonchi ho jati hai; satah ka farq osmotic pressure hai. Reverse osmosis: solution par lagaya gaya dabao (applied pressure) pani ko membrane se khalis pani ki taraf dhakelta hai aur contaminants peeche reh jate hain.
blocks.caption: Osmosis aur reverse osmosis (textbook ke Reverse osmosis box ki drawing ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.text: Active Transport

Plasma membrane ke aar-paar cheezon ka kam concentration se zyada concentration ki taraf energy kharch kar ke le jana active transport kehlata hai. Plasma membrane mein active transport ki yeh qismein hoti hain:
Active transport through carrier proteins (carrier proteins ke zariye)

Is amal mein plasma membrane ke carrier (transport) proteins energy istemal kar ke molecules ko concentration gradient ke khilaf (ulti simt) le jate hain. Misal ke taur par nerve cells ki membrane mein "sodium-potassium pump" naam ke carrier proteins hain. Aaram ki halat mein (jab nerve impulse nahi chal raha) nerve cell mein yeh pump energy (ATP) kharch kar ke cell ke andar K⁺ ki concentration zyada aur Na⁺ ki kam rakhta hai. Is ke liye pump Na⁺ ko zor laga kar cell se bahar aur K⁺ ko cell ke andar le jata hai.

blocks.alt: Cell ke bahar (oopar) aur cytoplasm (neeche) ke darmiyan plasma membrane, jis mein transport proteins chaar lagatar halaton mein. Na+ ions cytoplasm ki taraf se pump se jurte hain; ATP ek phosphate (P) deta hai aur ADP bachta hai; pump bahar ki taraf khul kar Na+ bahar chhorta hai; bahar se K+ ions jurte hain; pump phosphate chhor kar wapas palatta hai aur K+ ko cytoplasm mein chhor deta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.37: Carrier proteins ke zariye active transport (textbook ki Figure 3.37 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Outside cell, Transport protein, Plasma membrane, Na+, K+, P, ATP, ADP, Cytoplasm.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yahan ions kam concentration se zyada concentration ki taraf jate hain, is liye energy (ATP) chahiye. Na⁺ bahar aur K⁺ andar dhakele jate hain, aur ATP ka phosphate pump ki shakal badal deta hai.
Endocytosis

Endocytosis mein bari (bulky) cheezen plasma membrane ke paar cell ke andar laayi jati hain. Is dauran plasma membrane ka ek hissa andar ki taraf dab jata hai (invaginate). Bahar ki cheez is gaRhe mein aa jati hai aur us ke kinare band ho jate hain, aur ek chhoti vesicle (thaili) ban jati hai. Yeh vesicle plasma membrane se alag ho kar cytoplasm mein chali jati hai. Endocytosis ki do aam qismein phagocytosis aur pinocytosis hain. Phagocytosis (cell ka khana) mein cell thos (solid) cheez andar leta hai, aur pinocytosis (cell ka peena) mein cell maye (liquid) ko qatron (droplets) ki shakal mein andar leta hai.

Plasma membrane ke khaas receptor proteins bahar se cheez pakarte hain aur andar ki taraf dab kar vesicle bana lete hain. Misal: jigar (liver) ke cells mein cholesterol ke liye receptor proteins hain. Cholesterol hamare khoon mein low-density lipoproteins (LDLs) ki shakal mein ghoomta hai. Liver cells ki plasma membrane ke receptor proteins LDLs ko pehchan kar receptor-mediated endocytosis se khoon se andar le lete hain.
blocks.title: Receptor-mediated endocytosis

blocks.alt: LDL particle (proteins wali phospholipid bahari tah, andar cholesterol) plasma membrane ki taraf aata hai, membrane ke garhe mein receptor proteins se jurta hai, aur vesicle mein band ho kar cytoplasm mein chala jata hai.
blocks.caption: LDL ki receptor-mediated endocytosis (textbook ke Receptor-mediated endocytosis box ki drawing ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: LDL particle, Phospholipid outer layer, Cholesterol, Protein, Plasma membrane, Receptor protein, Vesicle, Cytoplasm.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke is box ki drawing mein LDL ke andar wale cholesterol ka label "Chloesterol" chhapa hai; sahi spelling cholesterol hai, aur drawing mein yahi likha gaya hai.
Exocytosis

Exocytosis woh amal hai jis se bari (bulky) cheezen cell se bahar bheji jati hain. Is mein bari cheez ek membrane mein pack ho kar vesicle ban jati hai. Yeh vesicle plasma membrane tak jati hai, us se jur jati hai aur apni cheezen cell ke bahar ke mahol mein chhor deti hai.

blocks.alt: (A) Endocytosis: cell ke bahar ka zarra plasma membrane ki andar ki taraf jeb (pocket) mein ghir jata hai jo toot kar cell ke andar vesicle ban jati hai; maada andar aa jata hai. (B) Exocytosis: andar band maade wale vesicles plasma membrane tak jate hain, us se mil kar khulte hain aur maada cell se bahar nikal jata hai.

blocks.caption: Simple diffusion, facilitated diffusion aur active transport
rows: Hamesha zyada se kam concentration ki taraf?

blocks.prompt: Endocytosis aur exocytosis ko active transport mein kyun gina jata hai halanke yeh akele molecules ko gradient ke khilaf pump nahin karte?
blocks.explanation: Dono mein cell ko tawanai kharch karni parti hai: vesicle banana, alag karna aur le jana, aur use membrane se milana, sab ATP istemal karte hain. Tawanai ka kharch, sirf simt nahin, kisi amal ko active banata hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Passive transport ko tawanai nahin chahiye aur yeh concentration gradient ke saath jata hai: simple diffusion (chhote non-polar molecules bilayer se), facilitated diffusion (polar ya charged molecules channel ya carrier proteins se; raftar proteins ki tadaad se mehdood) aur osmosis (pani chun kar guzarne-dene wali membrane se, hypotonic se hypertonic, aksar aquaporins se).
Tonicity: hypertonic mein zyada solute, hypotonic mein kam, isotonic mein barabar. Reverse osmosis dabao se pani ko ulti simt dhakel kar saaf karta hai.

Active transport ATP kharch karta hai: sodium-potassium pump jaise carrier pumps ions ko gradient ke khilaf le jate hain; endocytosis (phagocytosis, pinocytosis, receptor-mediated) bhari madda vesicles se andar lata hai; exocytosis use bahar bhejta hai.
